caption: The drawing consists of two outlined pattern pieces placed side by side near the upper center of the page, both labeled with letters and numbers. The left piece is labeled "A-3" at the bottom and includes a vertical label along the right side that reads "Braid + Fringe," with a solid and dotted line separating the top edge from the rest of the shape. The right piece is labeled "B-2" beneath the outline and features a diagonal dotted line toward the top. Below these shapes, a block of handwritten text in all capital letters provides detailed instructions, with some individual letters and symbols emphasized. The drawing and text are rendered in pencil on an off-white or beige paper, with the entire composition bordered by a hand-drawn rectangular frame. The title "Plate 2" is written in cursive at the top left above the frame.
title: Coat (Pattern)
